extension.description: The supply table at basic prices, including transformation into purchasers’ prices, shows how goods and services enter the economy, distinguishing domestic output by product and industry and imports by product. The table is compiled in accordance with ESA 2010 and records total supply at basic prices and its conversion to purchasers’ prices through trade and transport margins and taxes less subsidies on products. Products are classified according to CPA 2.1 and industries according to NACE Rev. 2. Table naio_10_pyp15 reports supply at previous year's prices.
